full_description:
**Glasses** mod will give you the opportunity to look at the world in a new way. The mod adds a total of 21 pairs of glasses.

**Crafting Recipes and Item IDs:**
Black Glasses (500) – 8 ink sacs + 1 glasses
Glasses (501) – 7 coal + 2 glass blocks
3D Glasses (502) – 3 roses + 2 coal + 3 lapis lazuli + 1 glasses
Green Glasses (503) – 8 lime dye + 1 glasses
Blue Glasses (504) – 8 lapis lazuli + 1 glasses
Yellow Glasses (505) – 8 dandelions + 1 glasses
Red Glasses (506) – 8 roses + 1 glasses
Purple Glasses (507) – 8 purple dye + 1 glasses
Orange Glasses (508) – 8 orange dye + 1 glasses
Brown Glasses (509) – 8 cocoa beans + 1 glasses
Pink Glasses (510) – 8 pink dye + 1 glasses
Dark Green Glasses (511) – 8 cacti + 1 glasses
Gold Glasses (512) – 7 gold ingots + 2 glass blocks
Diamond Glasses (513) – 7 diamonds + 2 glass blocks
Iron Glasses (514) – 7 iron ingots + 2 glass blocks
Emerald Glasses (515) – 7 emeralds + 2 glass blocks
Lapis Lazuli Glasses (516) – 7 lapis lazuli + 2 glass blocks
Redstone Glasses (517) – 7 redstone + 2 glass blocks
Pokémon Glasses (518) – 3 redstone + 3 iron ingots + 1 coal + 2 glass blocks
Money Glasses (519) – 3 lime dye + 3 cactus green + 1 glasses + 2 coal
Scouter (520) – 3 lime dye + 1 glass pane + 5 iron ingots

**How to Install Glasses:**
1. Download and install Block Launcher.
2. Download and extract the mod file.
3. Launch Block Launcher and tap the icon at the top of the screen.
4. Tap “BL Settings” → “Texture Pack” → “Import” → “Phone Storage” and select the mod’s texture pack.
5. Return to the main Block Launcher screen and tap the icon at the top of the screen.
6. Tap “ModPE Script” → “Add” → “Phone Storage” and select the mod’s JS file.

Done.
